scope: selected Amazon candidates and controls; retrospective quality-aware analysis, not preregistered

windows.date_only_sources: inclusive calendar-date filtering; exact within-day ordering is ambiguous on all timed window bounds (2026-07-24, 2026-08-23, 2026-09-04, 2026-10-04) and SAR dates unless source provides a timestamp

catalog_search.inventory_completeness: all advertised STAC next links followed for each point/window query until no next link; no total matched count supplied/verified; not a claim of complete Sentinel archive

sentinel2.scene_inventory_rule: all returned scenes in exact SAR-time-anchored 30-day windows; no item filtered by scene cloud metadata
sentinel2.pixel_method: read every unique SCL COG via Rasterio; transform each candidate lon/lat to asset CRS (recorded per scene), sample containing pixel
sentinel2.quality_aware_posthoc_rule: report full pixel inventory; exclude nodata, defective, cloud, shadow and unclassified categories; SCL 4 and 5 are equally eligible clear land classes, with no class preference; choose nearest in absolute time to exact SAR boundary, tie-break earlier UTC then item ID. This is retrospective, not preregistered.

broad_2026-08-14_to_2026-09-21_compariso.interpretation: explicitly wider, post-hoc optical bracket; cannot date disturbance or prove clearing

previous_selection_broad_pair_crosscheck.scene_rule: sample the same S2 2026-08-02, 2026-08-04, 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-21 SCL assets at all archived prior-selected coordinates; this is a retrospective comparison, not independent ground truth

sentinel2.interpretation: SCL classes 8/9 cloud probability and 3 shadow invalidate vegetation interpretation; class 5 means not-vegetated classification only, not proof of forest loss/clearing; class 4 vegetation is not proof of stable forest

inpe_deter.geometry_semantics: make_valid applied to invalid feature geometries; covers includes boundary; metric distance after projection to EPSG:32722
inpe_deter.date_semantics: view_date is date-only observation; same-calendar-day ordering is ambiguous; publish_month is month-only publication metadata, not exact release timestamp

local_glad_deter_alerts.geometry_semantics: Shapely make_valid for invalid inputs; covers includes boundary points; distance measured after EPSG:4326 to UTM 22S projection
local_glad_deter_alerts.source_limit: checked-in local collection; not queried as a complete real-time GLAD archive

local_firms_screen.limitation: FIRMS/INPE active-fire points, not burn polygons; repeat detections may be one fire

other_source_access.GLAD_live: No unauthenticated query/download endpoint established in this run; GFW Data API access is documented as authentication-required. Checked-in GeoJSON only was inspected.
other_source_access.independent_amazon_event: No independently confirmed event linked to the revised Amazon SAR candidates/controls was verified in the sources checked; this is insufficient evidence, not evidence of no event.
other_source_access.NISAR_outside_Amazon: No independently published matching event identified in accessible checked-in/public sources during this audit.

remote_asset_hash_policy: STAC/WFS JSON response bodies are saved and SHA-256 recorded; full SCL COG bytes/range responses are not archived or content-hashed, only item IDs, asset URLs and sampled values are preserved
limitations: SCL is a categorical cloud/land-cover classifier, not a deforestation label or independent confirmation.
Scene cloud-cover percentage is scene-wide metadata, not pixel-level cloudiness; pixel SCL is reported separately.
DETER view date and publish month do not establish exact public availability on any given day; date-only records on SAR dates have ambiguous ordering.
The fixed +/-30-day windows are descriptive and do not prove event absence outside them; broad SCL brackets are post-hoc and cannot date a change.
Candidate/control cells may share a spatially correlated disturbance; no independent event counting.
